title: DAOS Intent / Intent 定义
description: A compiled intent that has passed policy check and is ready for simulation/execution / 已通过策略检查、准备模拟/执行的编译后 Intent

id.description: Unique intent identifier / 唯一 Intent 标识符

timestamp.description: Intent creation time / Intent 创建时间

actor.description: LLM or agent that proposed this intent / 提出此 Intent 的 LLM 或代理

action.description: Action to perform / 要执行的操作

target_node.description: Hostname matching nodes.yaml / 匹配 nodes.yaml 的主机名

params.description: Action-specific parameters / 操作特定参数

pre_snapshot.description: Pre-execution snapshot for rollback / 执行前用于回滚的快照

path.description: Snapshot storage path / 快照存储路径

hash.description: Snapshot hash for integrity verification / 快照完整性哈希

rollback_steps.description: Steps to rollback this intent / 回滚此 Intent 的步骤

type.description: Rollback step type / 回滚步骤类型

command.description: Shell command to execute / 要执行的 shell 命令

verify_command.description: Command to verify rollback success / 验证回滚成功的命令

verify_steps.description: Metrics to verify after execution / 执行后要验证的指标

tolerance.description: Acceptable tolerance / 可接受误差范围

policy_results.description: Results from OPA policy checks / OPA 策略检查结果

network_allowed.description: Network policy passed / 网络策略通过

execution_allowed.description: Execution policy passed / 执行策略通过

trust_verified.description: Trust verification passed / 信任验证通过

rate_limited.description: Rate limit in effect / 速率限制生效

simulation_id.description: Link to simulation run if applicable / 模拟运行 ID（如适用）

provenance.description: Provenance tracking fields / 来源追踪字段

source_hash.description: Hash of baseline source / 基线源哈希

policy_version.description: Policy version at time of check / 检查时的策略版本
